# Excel Unit Technology — KSA
> Saudi Arabia subsidiary of Excel Unit Technology Ltd (Hong Kong), authorized CommScope (SYSTIMAX, NETCONNECT) and CPI Chatsworth distribution. Licensed for trading & import in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (CR 7054452607, Riyadh). 2,000+ products ex-stock with air freight to Riyadh, Jeddah and Dammam. Arabic-first website.

## What we supply
- SYSTIMAX: enterprise & data-center cabling (GigaSPEED X10D Cat6A, LazrSPEED OM4/OM5, TeraSPEED OS2, Propel, imVision AIM)
- NETCONNECT: commercial copper & fiber; CPI Chatsworth racks & power; KRONE voice systems
